$comment: Name kept as `plugin-spec` for now. It reads as 'a specification for plugins', which is not what
this is — a visualised spec-driven development board. Renaming is a CEO decision, cheap while the
repo is private and unpublished and permanent the moment someone installs it.
The `hooks` key is gone because v1's briefing hook was deleted in the pivot to the board. `skills`
is loaded by CONVENTION from skills/ — do not list it here. Naming it registers it a second time and
Claude Code rejects the duplicate ('Duplicate hooks file detected'), failing the whole load. Verify
with `claude --plugin-dir . plugin list` — the only thing that reads this file; nothing in the
repo's own tests can catch a mistake here.
name: plugin-spec
description: A visualised spec-driven development board: every screen as PRD → wireframe → screenshot → test, staleness derived rather than tracked, and two human gates — is this what I meant, and did you build it.
